title: My Journey
description: When I first started coding I had no idea what I was doing. Everything looked like random symbols on a screen. I spent way too many hours on YouTube tutorials just to get the basics down. Then one day I found Tkinter in Python and suddenly I could build stuff with a real interface. My first real project was a food ordering app based on my school cafeteria menu. Nothing fancy, but I was hooked. From there I just kept going, picked up new languages, started bigger projects, and never really stopped.
subTitle: Right now I'm into Linux server management and building APIs.
subDescription: Now let me show you some of my projects.

title: My Experience
description: I've been writing code for about 5 years now. Started with Python, then moved into JavaScript and TypeScript for both frontend and backend. I spend most of my time building APIs and writing object oriented code. I can put together full pages in Angular and get them running on an AWS server. I also picked up some C++ and Java basics in school, enough to understand how things work under the hood. I just like figuring things out and getting better at what I do, one project at a time.
subTitle: Writing code since I was 13.

title: Skills I have Learned
description: Python was my starting point. OOP, Tkinter, Pycord, SQLite, all that good stuff. After about a year I jumped into TypeScript and Angular, which is what I mainly use for web projects now. I also run Linux on a VM where I host my Discord bot and manage everything with cron jobs. Lately I've been getting into API development with Express, which has been fun to learn.
subTitle: Always picking up something new. Tools, frameworks, whatever catches my interest.
